snippet.title: Monster Train 2 - Official Release Date Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
MONSTER TRAIN 2 RELEASES MAY 21 2025

With five all-new clans, dozens of new cards, and many new modes, Monster Train 2 is going to be off the rails! Wishlist on Steam and play the demo today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2742830/Monster_Train_2/

More info:
https://www.bigfangames.com/games/monster-train-2

Developed by Shiny Shoe. Published by Big Fan Games.
